messages:
Rhea Patel: Quick hub thread for the tri-mode launch copy sweep (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need: single-line hero, a short benchmark or trust stamp, two CTA variants (product & enterprise), and a lightweight inbound routing plan. Freeze Wed EOD.
Markus Lee: I can pull a concise Dedicated throughput line for the micro-callout. Also want the Dedicated CTA to surface capacity sizing requests.
Sam - copy: Ill draft three micro-headlines per mode and two CTAs each (A/B). Will avoid repeating existing hero phrasing. Hosted will be dev-forward and short.
Riley (growth): Routing outline: Hosted -> self-serve; Dedicated -> AE demo queue; Private -> AE + security. Immediate AE if form contains keywords like "HIPAA", "SOC2", "on-prem" or if estimated_mrr > 10k. Also tag leads with utm_content for variant mapping.
Jo (analytics): Proposal: run a microtest where Hosted hero has a small "performance stamp" vs no-stamp. Metric: cta_click -> signup conversion. Instrument event property variant=stamp|control.
Rhea Patel: Good. Sam, can you keep the Hosted hero number-light and use the stamp as the place to show a simple claim like "Sub-200ms 99th (typical)" with a tooltip caveat?
Sam - copy: Drafts incoming. Hosted hero candidates: 1) "Hosted API. Build now, scale fast." 2) "Start with low-latency hosted inference." Stamp text: "Sub-200ms 99th on representative flows"; tooltip: "Results vary by model and request pattern. See bench lab." CTAs: "Start free" / "See benchmark demo"
Markus Lee: Dedicated hero candidate: "Reserve GPU pools for predictable throughput." Subline: "SLA-backed capacity and autoscale options." Micro-callout placeholder: "~170k tokens/sec per cluster (typical)" (will confirm). CTAs: "Request capacity review" / "Get pricing"
Sam - copy: Private hero candidates: 1) "Private deployments: VPC, on-prem, customer-managed keys." 2) "Enterprise controls with audit logs and KMS." CTAs: "Talk to sales" / "Request security brief"
Riley (growth): UTM scheme: ?utm_source=site&utm_campaign=tri_hub_test&utm_content={variant}. Variant values: badge_A, badge_B, enterprise_A, enterprise_B. Map utm_content -> SFDC queue. Ill draft YAML after copy freeze.
Jo (analytics): Also add event landing_stamp_view and landing_stamp_click. Capture property stamp_text. We'll run the test for 10k visitors or 2 weeks, whichever first.
Sam - copy: Webinar tie-in (Hosted): "Live lab: batching & cache to lower inference cost  30-min demo + Q&A." CTA: "Register". We'll surface this on the Hosted secondary CTA for the stamp variant.
Markus Lee: Confirming Dedicated stat tomorrow AM with infra. If number not ready, use descriptive micro-callout and link to docs for technical details.
ops-bot: Reminder: copy freeze scheduled at 1798963200 (Wed 23:59 UTC).
Rhea Patel: Next steps: Sam posts final hero + stamp text + two CTAs per page by EOD today. Riley posts routing YAML & UTM mapping after that. Markus confirms Dedicated number. Jo wires analytics events. Design will mock A/B once copy lands. Thanks team. :rocket:
